subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配体分类：下列配体属于哪一种 L/X 类型：dppe (1,2-bis(diphenylphosphino)ethane)（dppe）？
A. L₂
B. X₃
C. L₂X₂
D. X₂
explanation: dppe (dppe (1,2-bis(diphenylphosphino)ethane)) is an L₂ ligand: each L gives 2 electrons and each X one, so 4 electrons in the covalent count (4 in the ionic count).
